description.id: Kelola record DNS untuk domain yang tersinkron, termasuk CNAME yang dipakai tunnel.
description.en: Manage DNS records for synced domains, including the CNAMEs your tunnels use.

empty_zones_desc.id: Sinkronkan akun agar domain yang token-nya bisa dijangkau muncul di sini.
empty_zones_desc.en: Sync the accounts so the domains their tokens can reach show up here.

empty_records.en: This domain has no records yet.

no_zone.en: Pick a domain to see its records.

truncated.id: Menampilkan {{shown}} record pertama; zona ini punya lebih banyak.
truncated.en: Showing the first {{shown}} records; this zone has more.

managed_hint.id: Record ini dipakai aplikasi publik. Ubah dari halaman tunnel agar ingress dan DNS tetap sinkron.
managed_hint.en: This record is used by a published app. Change it from the tunnel page so ingress and DNS stay in sync.

delete_confirm.id: Hapus record {{type}} {{name}}? Perubahan langsung berlaku di Cloudflare.
delete_confirm.en: Delete the {{type}} record {{name}}? The change applies to Cloudflare immediately.

tunnel.id: Baris bertipe Tunnel adalah CNAME ke <id>.cfargotunnel.com: trafik masuk lewat cloudflared, bukan langsung ke origin.
tunnel.en: A Tunnel row is a CNAME to <id>.cfargotunnel.com: traffic enters through cloudflared instead of hitting the origin directly.

locked.id: Record milik aplikasi publik dikunci di sini. Edit atau hapus lewat halaman tunnel supaya aturan ingress dan DNS tidak berbeda.
locked.en: Records owned by a published app are locked here. Edit or delete them from the tunnel page so ingress and DNS cannot disagree.

permissions.id: Token Cloudflare butuh Zone:Read untuk melihat dan Zone:DNS:Edit untuk menulis record.
permissions.en: The Cloudflare token needs Zone:Read to list and Zone:DNS:Edit to write records.

ttl.id: TTL Auto mengikuti Cloudflare. Record yang di-proxy selalu memakai TTL Auto.
ttl.en: Auto TTL follows Cloudflare. A proxied record always uses Auto TTL.

name_hint.id: Kosongkan atau isi @ untuk akar domain. Contoh: app, www, _dmarc.
name_hint.en: Leave empty or use @ for the apex. Examples: app, www, _dmarc.

proxied_hint.id: Hanya untuk A, AAAA, dan CNAME. Matikan untuk DNS only.
proxied_hint.en: A, AAAA and CNAME only. Turn it off for DNS only.

create_desc.en: The record is written straight to Cloudflare.

edit_desc.en: The change applies to Cloudflare immediately.
